positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded Software Engineer on the Supplies Security Team

Responsibilities: 
- Develop HP Inkjet printers as part of the R&D Supplies Security Firmware Team.
- Own, Design, implement, and support HP security features in C and C++.
- Led cross functional teams to maintain enterprise scale code base.
- Collaborated with teams globally in Barcelona, Singapore, South Korea, and Bangalore.
- Developed automated test code in Python and unit tests using GoogleTest.
- Scoped engineering work per business schedule and program needs in an Agile development environment.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Develop HP Office Printing Solutions as part of the R&D Low Level Print Firmware Team
- Design and implement test code in C# to ensure complete test coverage of all aspects of the product code
- Test and debug printing software with emulators, simulators, and engines to ensure world class quality to meet product and user requirements
- Self-taught and employ visual studio with the programming languages C#, C++, and Python
- Lead bi-weekly Korean cultural sessions to aid in the integration of the Samsung Print acquisition

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
-	Managed AIESEC Brightens Children’s dream (ABC) project to teach English, and world cultures to elementary school students in underprivileged schools in the Eunpyung district
-	Initiated and ran global intern program, bringing foreign college students from Taiwan, Poland, Malaysia, China, and Romania to participate in the ABC program
-	Ran fundraising efforts to support intern program. Successfully raised money from WorldVision and the Republic of Korea’s University Council for Social Service
-	Participated in bi-annual international leadership seminars
-	Volunteered in Turkey for 8 weeks, introduced Korean culture to over 500 Turkish high school students
